sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
name: The visiting cook

lines.text: The hearth is here because the smoke leaves by the upper crack. A sheltered flame is not the same as a smoky sleeping place.
I cook here for a little while, then take my pot to another household. The cave keeps its name when the cook changes.
If you bring news of the water jars, I will listen while this warms. Nobody has to earn a place beside the fire.

notes: Intermittent helper; the game derives visits from journey day, never a permanent third occupant.
